scope: Exact scalar and algebraic checks plus labelled floating point illustrations; not formal verification or a new numerical sign certificate.

checks.name: elementary e brackets
checks.detail: sum through degree 3 is >5/2; sum through degree 4 plus geometric tail 1/100 is <11/4

checks.name: log N above 8 for N at least 4096
checks.detail: e^2<8 implies e^8<4096

checks.name: theta derivative polynomial
checks.detail: (8tau^3+32tau^2+18tau)/tau^3<21 for tau>3

checks.name: prefactor logarithm less than 18
checks.detail: log25+9+log132=9+log3300<18 since e>5/2

checks.name: sqrt coefficient 33
checks.detail: 4sqrt66<33

checks.name: whole ray prefactor ratio decreases
checks.detail: log derivative at s>=8 is 1/(s+9)+1/(2s)-1<0

checks.name: whole ray absorption
checks.detail: 36N/sqrt(s)-5v<=-4v when v>=100N/sqrt(s)

checks.name: complete paired prime tail
checks.detail: 8 sum_{n>Y}e^-2n<1 for every Y>=1, using e>2

checks.name: adaptive derivative exponent
checks.detail: e224 times e8 times e4 yields squared factor e236 and norm factor e118

checks.name: boundary coefficient identity
checks.detail: [120sqrt(d)/(2^(3/4)sqrt(pi))]^2=1 at d=pi sqrt2/7200
